name: Declarative agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)
short_description: A declarative agent customizes Microsoft 365 Copilot with instructions, knowledge sources and actions while running on Copilot's own orchestrator and models and inheriting its security and compliance.

evidence.quote: A declarative agent borrows Copilot's own engine and models, which keeps it simple and means it inherits Microsoft's
It lets you create what Microsoft calls declarative agents.
The new focus is co-pilot studio and declarative agents as the first class development story
Path one, Copilot Studio, declarative agents for makers and low-code teams.
Agentes declarativos para creadores y equipos de código bajo.
